items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: And we was playing there with Walter Nelson, one of the greatest blues guitar players in New Orleans. I am playing with him right now at this time right now.

ctx.x: Around that time, didn't you get an offer from Sidney Boucher to join him in Boston? A few years after that, at least.

Yeah, when Sidney came down here to play the jazz concert at the auditorium with Lewis Armstrong, he had a chance to hear me. He had a chance to hear me. At that time, I was playing with Walter Nelson. He is standing right behind me at the Silver Store at St. Bernard and in that street, I think, or 8 Court. And we was playing there with Walter Nelson, one of the greatest blues guitar players in New Orleans. I am playing with him right now at this time right now. He's standing right over me.
